relations.evidence: somasarmaṇasyārthena|| svaputra dvijavara śrīamṛtadevena likhitam idṃ

date.as_written: samvat 580 mārgaśiraśukla|| trayodaśī pra| caturddaśyāyān(!) tithau|| rohiṇi(!) nakṣatre|| śubhayoge|| śanīścaravāsare(!)

purpose: for the sake of Agnihotrin Somaśarman (somasarmaṇasyārthena)
notes: The beneficiary's name is given as 'śrīvaṃkulideva agniotra somasarmaṇasya', likely a single individual (Vaṅkulideva Somaśarman) combining a personal/local name ending in -deva with the ritual title Agnihotra and the Brahmanical name Somaśarman. 'Sohalanīmha Brahmapura' likely refers to a settlement or guthi of sixteen Brahmins (sohala nimha in Newari).
